content: It can take anywhere from 1 to 4 years for a solar panel to become carbon neutral, depending on factors such as the manufacturing process, the efficiency of the panel, and the amount of sunlight it receives. Once a solar panel has offset the carbon emissions generated during its production and installation, it will continue to produce clean energy for many more years, further reducing its overall carbon footprint.
